headline: On October 31, 2020: Berlin Brandenburg Airport finally opens
captionCards: Berlin Brandenburg Airport delayed 10 years due to corruption
Now serves as a key hub for European and intercontinental flights
instagramCaption:
Berlin Brandenburg Airport welcomes its first passengers. \\[After nearly 10 years of delays due to construction issues and project corruption, Berlin Brandenburg Airport opened its doors on October 31, 2020. The airport, located 18 km south-east of Berlin's city center, serves as a base for airlines like Condor and easyJet. Despite the setbacks, it now offers flights to European and some intercontinental destinations. This event marked a significant milestone in Germany's infrastructure development. \\Why do you think such a large project faced so many delays? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
